Lemma
[The regular part is embedded]

↗ prop:regular-level-set-hypersurface

In the setting of Proposition 5, the inclusion $M_c\hookrightarrow M$ is a topological embedding.

Proof

\sketch Both $M_c\hookrightarrow \mathcal R$ and $\mathcal R\hookrightarrow M$ are subspace inclusions and topological embeddings; so is their composite.

□
